task: held-out source query at an observed frequency on a co-located 9-transducer multistatic array
context_order: same-target-frequency sources first; target source is always absent

stage2.loss: normalized smooth L1 + 0.5 physical raw relative L2

selection: validation Q2 K=8 only; test opened after architecture and loss were frozen
primary_metric: system-equal raw complex relative L2 at K=8
strong_baseline: gain-calibrated reciprocity with training-set mean for unfilled entries
gate: at least 15 percent relative improvement over the strong baseline on held-out systems
